text:
Zoe: Anyone else seeing a sudden spike in 429s for /v1/generate? Dashboards show a lot of orgs reporting burst=0 applied around 01:37 UTC :eyes:
Sanjay: yep, I'm seeing alerts from the throttler. rate-limiter metrics show a sharp increase starting ~01:36 UTC. looks like per-org burst windows collapsed.
ops-bot: [alert] throttler.429.rate_limit_exceeded route=/v1/generate window=5m count=2890 region=us-west-2
Eli: I pulled the quota audit log — there was a console change deployed during the midnight rollout. Patch updated quota defaults and accidentally set defaultBurst=0 for scope=org. full audit snippet below:
```
PATCH /api/quotas/defaults
{
  "scope": "org",
  "defaultBurst": 0,
  "defaultRate": 20
}
```
Maya: Oof. That 0 burst is essentially removing burst capacity. Was that intentional for the new token bucket experiment?
Eli: No, looks like a typo in the migration script. The intention was to set "defaultBurst": null (inherit) but the migration coerced missing value to 0.
Luca (oncall): Can we roll this back quickly? Affected customers are seeing degraded UX.
Sanjay: I'm on it. Planning a rollback to the previous defaults for org scope. Will push a targeted config patch to RBAC-scoped quota service.
Eli: For visibility — console deploy job 2026-03-18T00:58:12Z applied quotas-migration v2.3.4. Deployment logs show the migration ran across every region without canary.
Zoe: Why did this go full rollout without a canary? That seems like the root process issue.
Maya: The rollout policy was changed last week to speed up non-critical console fixes; looks like this migration was misclassified. We'll open a follow-up to revert that policy.
Sanjay: Rolling back now. Command:
```
# rollback quota defaults to pre-migration values
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/ops/quotas/rollback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_KEY" \
  -d '{"migration_tag":"quotas-mig-20260318","scope":"org"}'
```
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (job_id=rb-20260318-1775001), starting targeted patch to quota-service in us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1.
ops-bot: [event] rollback started job_id=rb-20260318-1775001
Eli: I'm running a quick script to re-evaluate affected orgs and bump their burst to safe defaults while rollback completes.
Zoe: Heads-up to success/rep teams — we should proactively message affected customers.
Luca (oncall): 429 counts dropping in us-west-2 already. Pre-rollback peak 429 rate=1200/min -> now 400/min and trending down.
Sanjay: Rollback completed across all regions. Verified config: defaultBurst for scope=org reverted to 100 (previous default).
deploy-bot: rollback job rb-20260318-1775001 completed successfully in 00:03:42.
Maya: Will follow up with a postmortem (root cause: migration coercion + rollout policy change). Action items: 1) add canary for console migrations, 2) validation to prevent 0 burst for org scope, 3) fix migration to use explicit null/inherit semantics.
Eli: Also adding an automated canary metric for burst==0 anomalies in the throttler so ops get earlier signals.
Zoe: Thanks y'all — please add the customer impact list and timeline to the incident doc. :raised_hands:
Sanjay: Adding notes to incidents/1775001000.
ops-bot: [resolved] incident 1775001000 - quota migration rollback complete (duration ~00:06).
